description: Composes the session GET with the consolidations list. Returns the authorized role, decision counts, latest snapshot, and the current HTML visual-projection lifecycle with a safe reason code. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.
name: get_review
